design_philosophy: Authoritative, modern, corporate SaaS dashboard emphasizing data clarity and functional beauty. Prioritizes sharp grids, high-contrast monochrome bases with deliberate color accents for financial states. Neutral, analytical, objective.

layout.spacing_scale: Generous: Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Dashboard grid gaps: gap-6.
layout.dashboard_grid: Grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for dense data. Span-2 for main charts.
layout.surface_styles: Cardless or sharp rectangular edges. 1px solid border (border-slate-200), max 8px rounded corners (rounded-lg). Minimal ambient shadow (shadow-sm).
layout.alignment: Left-align dense content. Top-right for card actions.

motion.loading: Shimmer effects or skeleton loaders for data blocks.

components.navigation: Sidebar with active states marked by strong left-border or deep background fill. Sticky header with user avatar and quick actions.
components.smart_calculator: Segmented controls for Weekly/Fortnightly/Monthly. Visual progress bar indicating Safety Buffer vs Actual Bill.
components.tables: Shadcn table. No vertical borders, strict horizontal 1px separators. Hover state on rows.
components.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Use primary and accent colors. Avoid pure green/red unless explicitly indicating profit/loss. For general analytics, use #2563EB and #0F172A.
components.buttons: Primary: Solid #0F172A with white text. Secondary: Outline with transparent bg and slate border. High contrast hover states.

icons.usage: Use 1.25rem (20px) icons, stroke-width 1.5. Colors should match text hierarchy. For utility providers, use Lucide icons inside colored circular backgrounds (e.g. bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 for water).

avatars.description: Professional male avatar with blue shirt and gray waistcoat
Professional male avatar posing in a suit

backgrounds.description: Blurred modern office space with lights
Bright abstract blue and white space

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize data clarity and information hierarchy over decorative elements. Ensure the Admin and Customer dashboards feel like robust SaaS products.

Implement the Smart Calculator using a visually engaging component (segmented toggle for Weekly/Fortnightly/Monthly) showing real-time deduction updates and a visual representation of the safety buffer vs actual bill.
Use Shadcn UI components extensively but heavily customize the styling (remove heavy rounded borders, keep it max rounded-lg, use crisp 1px borders).
For Admin dashboard, ensure charts (Recharts) follow the color palette (use #2563EB and #0F172A).
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case (e.g. `data-testid="submit-bill-btn"`).
Add font links for Outfit (Headings) and Manrope (Body) in the base HTML/CSS.
Structure the layout with a fixed sidebar (Admin/Customer toggle or routes) and a scrollable main area.
